question: Will the IOM Missing Migrants Project record at least 900 Mediterranean migrant deaths in 2026 before April 2026?
summary: Ensemble aggregate is high (92%), but objections indicate meaningful downside risks to hitting 900 by end-March.
Threshold arithmetic suggests 294 additional deaths in March would be required, which is plausible given early-2026 pace, but not guaranteed due to weather, policy/SAR changes, and reporting lags.
Data indicate about 606 deaths by late February 2026; continued high pace is possible but uncertain; no formal near-term forecast models are published in sources.
Adjusting downward accounts for downside risks while preserving plausibility of the threshold being breached; no implausible scenario invoked.
